content: Operation cycles Type: valid Description: The Diagnostic Extract shall support the specification of operation cycles. Rationale: The AUTOSAR diagnostic stack supports the configuration of operation cycles. This aspect shall therefore be supported by the Diagnostic Extract. Use Case: The user wants to assign a specific operation cycle to a diagnostic event depending on the project needs. Dependencies:  Supporting Material: More information can be found in the specification of the AUTOSAR Diagnostic Event Manager [4].
